 입력 2026.11.04. 22:32 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 
 On the 4th at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 2 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions was held.
 After KT beat Samsung 8-7 in Game 1 the previous day, Game 2 featured a starting matchup between KT's Ko Young-pyo and Samsung's Chris Flexen.
 With two outs and runners on second and third in the top of the 11th inning of extra innings, KT's Kim Jeong-un struck out Samsung's Park Gye-beom looking and celebrated. 2026.11.04
